question: Which names describe the lord as foundational giver present to all domains?
premises: He is called support of supports and maker of abodes.
He is called giver of all and within range of all.
inference: These names portray the lord as foundational, creative, generous, and universally pervasive.
uncertainties: dhāma can mean abode, light, or power; sarva+gocaraḥ can mean all-pervading or accessible to all.
plain_english: Support of supports, maker of abodes, giver of all, and pervading all.
